name: Dynamic Sampling with Recursive Sample Splitting
definition: An adaptive resampling scheme that dynamically places additional samples in areas with greater shading error to accurately model sharp shading variations (e.g., light shafts) that sparse sampling misses.
summary: Dynamic Sampling with Recursive Sample Splitting is an adaptive resampling scheme that uses a gradient-based error metric to recursively replace high-error samples with finer grid vertices, accurately modeling sharp shading variations missed by sparse sampling.
